# Senior housing partners meeting, 2026-03-12

Wendeline met the activity directors at Birchwood Commons and Larch Terrace about the [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]] in their buildings.

- Birchwood would like a monthly book cart in the lobby in addition to door visits. Wendeline will try it in April.
- Larch Terrace asked that volunteers sign in at the front desk; this is now part of [[Volunteer screening for home visits]].
- Both directors will refer new residents using the form in [[How to sign up a patron for home visits]].
